evidence_excerpts: A significant positive correlation was found between previous psychedelic use and shifts away from the hard-materialism pole of the hard-materialism vs. hard-dualism spectrum at baseline (r = 0.223, p < 0.0001).
Lifetime psychedelic use was positively correlated with panpsychist views and negatively correlated with hard materialistic views measured at baseline.
text: Greater lifetime psychedelic use correlates with stronger baseline panpsychist beliefs and weaker baseline hard materialist beliefs.
